phase_semantics.settle: after both physical front wheel centres clear the edge by 0.02 m and exceed deck_z + 0.70 * wheel_radius, override observation vx for 30 policy steps
phase_semantics.push: after the 30-step settle window until the router independently verifies all four wheels clear

front_tuck_command_profile.unmatched_behavior: keep the frozen entry command and do not extrapolate a profile

policy_symmetry.handoff_input: calibrated base yaw relative to the fixed Gate16 +X normal, frozen on armed heightmap-gate entry
policy_symmetry.input_lifetime: freeze from CLIMB handoff through CLIMB_EXIT
policy_symmetry.runner_api: stable-native canonical window plus b824 adaptive-v3 off-axis mirror bands + explicit router residual arm + heightmap edge timing
policy_symmetry.canonical_override: abs(entry_yaw)<=7.5 deg uses native after full-stack center mirroring caused repeatable lateral divergence; off-axis b824 bands remain unchanged

racing_integration.entry_heading_source: calibrated base yaw relative to measured Gate16 +X normal
racing_integration.shadow_condition: evaluate the unarmed Gate16 base from APPROACH at 3.0 m while official remains sole actuator owner
racing_integration.prewarm_condition: warm Gate16 base takes ownership at the 0.90 m staging point with abs(yaw)<=2.5 deg and abs(lateral)<=0.08 m
racing_integration.prewarm_forward_calibration: full-stack obstacle-normal progress bracket: command 0.18 produced approximately 0.19 m/s and command 0.25 produced approximately 0.27 m/s
racing_integration.residual_arm_request: gate16_climb only after CLIMB_READY proves the entry contract
racing_integration.safe_hold_location: aligned staging point, nominally 0.90 m before the lip
